The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Regarding the cloud computing security issues in the text, the primary vulnerability lies in the misconfiguration of network access controls for data storage. Specifically, the e-commerce platform failed to restrict access to its public cloud storage buckets, leaving them open to the internet. This lack of proper access control allowed unauthorized entities to access the data, resulting in data leaks. This highlights a critical failure in identity and access management (IAM) and storage security best practices, where default or overly permissive settings were not corrected to ensure that only authorized users or services could interact with the stored data.
